title: Manifest
description: Body of a 200 response to GET /app/v1/manifest. Source: nightshift-client/idea.md 3.1, plus the optional ui object decided in plan.md section 2 and the capability vocabulary from ADR-0006. This is what the client fetches when adding a connection, and what the conformance harness reads first to decide which checks apply.

schema.description: Envelope version of the manifest document itself.

agent.description: Identity of the agent. Display-only; the bearer token is identity for auth purposes.

contract.description: Which contract, at which major version, this agent claims to implement.

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities (ADR-0006). Declaring one is binding: the agent MUST serve the routes it gates. Routes for undeclared capabilities MUST 404. The vocabulary is open — unknown strings are ignored, never rejected, so new capabilities are additive. The 'contains' clause enforces the contract rule that every agent MUST declare 'chat'; the chat triad is core and gates nothing.

ui.description: Optional. When present, home names a ui:// resource the agent serves from its MCP endpoint, and clients treat it as the default Apps screen (plan.md section 2, decision 2).
